Introduction

NINE.i is a seven-member South Korean boy group. Formed by FirstOne Entertainment, they debuted as a ten-member group on March 30, 2022, with the mini album "New World", after being introduced through the conceptual project "The Birth of a New Algorithm."

In March 2024, all members except Eden revealed they were in a legal dispute with FirstOne, which was later resolved by June, with the group announcing plans for a fresh start.

Over time, the group underwent several lineup changes. Winnie departed in January 2024 due to a shoulder injury. Later Joohyoung left the group in March 2025, followed by Seowon in June 2025.
